fusions.name: Shock Cavalry
fusions.desc: Rushes up to 6 tiles to the target and rams it for 16 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Iron Tide
fusions.desc: Tramples through a narrow path 6 tiles ahead, dealing 34 damage that ignores armour to everything in it. Each has a 50% chance to be [Hindered] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Full Barding
fusions.desc: Plates you in barding that absorbs 24 damage across up to 4 blows for 8 seconds and raises your armour by 10%. You move 10% faster for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Shaken Into Place
fusions.desc: After you cover enough ground, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
